name: cartograph
description: A code knowledge graph for AI coding agents, as a CLI and a skills pack. No MCP server.

commands.title: Cartograph: Install Skills and Hooks into Workspace
Cartograph: Sync Memory from Copilot Logs
Cartograph: Install Cartograph Local (for remote windows)

cartograph.home.markdownDescription: Directory holding the `carto` launcher that Copilot CLI and Copilot Chat find on PATH. Defaults to `~/.cartograph`, which is also where the engine keeps its per-user state.

cartograph.installIntoWorkspace.markdownDescription: On activation, run `carto install` so the skills pack is present in `.github/skills` and the hooks in `.github/hooks`. Turn off to manage those files yourself.

cartograph.statusBar.description: Show graph state in the status bar.

cartograph.readCopilotLogs.markdownDescription: Keep memory from Copilot's own conversation logs as well as its hooks. Copilot writes these logs on this machine whether or not hooks run; an organization can switch Chat hooks off by policy (`chat.useHooks`), and this is then the only way Chat sessions are remembered. Only prompts not already recorded by a hook are imported. Turn off to rely on hooks alone.
